supersedes.reason: v1 INVALID: encodings for outer-FIT rows were computed from folds including the outer evaluation fold's labels (contamination of training features by eval-fold labels); prereg_sha256 was 'TODO'; decision rule applied raw augmentation delta instead of the frozen operational port_delta rule. v1 result preserved as history, classified INVALID.

scope: F2 fold-0 screen, strict fold-safe re-measurement of smoothed categorical target statistics (Bayesian shrinkage) for 4 categorical features (Gender, Customer Type, Type of Travel, Class).

protocol.outer_split: primary fold-0 = EVAL (139927 rows); folds 1-4 = outer-FIT (559708 rows).
protocol.encodings_for_eval_rows: Computed from outer-FIT rows ONLY (folds 1-4 statistics). Evaluation-fold labels never enter any eval encoding.
protocol.encodings_for_fit_rows: Inner cross-fitted WITHIN outer-FIT only: split outer-FIT into 4 inner folds (inner fold id = primary fold id - 1, i.e. folds 1,2,3,4 -> inner 0,1,2,3). Each outer-FIT row receives a smoothed encoding computed from the other three outer-FIT inner folds. No outer-FIT row ever sees its own label; no encoding anywhere uses fold-0 labels.
protocol.early_stopping_isolation: Inner 10% ES split carved from FIT rows only, stratified, seed 1. ES labels are used only as an eval_set metric for LightGBM early stopping; ES rows' features come from the inner cross-fit above (other inner folds only), so ES labels are not encoded into any feature. Control and treatment use the identical ES split.
protocol.model: LGBM xt_xt_f10 recipe (lr 0.02, leaves 127, extra_trees, ES 250, 6000 cap, seed 1), identical for control and treatment.
protocol.smoothing: Bayesian shrinkage: smoothed = w*cat_mean + (1-w)*global_mean, w = count/(count+alpha), alpha = 10.0; global_mean and cat stats computed only from the permitted training rows described above.

frozen_decision_rule.source: v1 prereg decision_rule text, applied literally as written:
frozen_decision_rule.text: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995

operationalization.port_delta: AUC(equal-logit blend(candidate_fold0, operational_portfolio_fold0)) - AUC(operational_portfolio_fold0), where operational_portfolio = sol_route_aux10_primary_final OOF (champion-v7 OOF is not archived in the store; route reference is the operational proxy used across Phase 20 screens).
operationalization.note: Raw augmentation delta (treatment - control on 21raw) is reported for mechanism description ONLY and is NOT the decision rule.
